mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 shows a sustained decline over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in real personal savings signals a shift in consumer behavior towards spending, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer discretionary sectors benefit.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase & RSAFS decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST increases and RSAFS decreases simultaneously within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate combined with an increase in the consumer price index signals an inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as inflation expectations boost commodity and cyclical sectors.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease & CPIAUCSL increase in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases simultaneously within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls combined with an increase in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity slows and consumer spending declines.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decrease & UNRATE increase in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS decreases and UNRATE increases simultaneously within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal savings over two consecutive months signals a shift towards saving and away from spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer discretionary sectors underperform.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS shows a sustained increase over two consecutive months.
